review_type: Independent static code/evidence review; no tests rerun
reviewer: Separate delegated reviewer; parent verified the cited parser branches

findings.scope: Pre-freeze parser consistency and retry evidence
findings.summary: Malformed completion/audit-looking lines are silently skipped and omitted from the retry fingerprint.
control_flow: An additional malformed event-looking line after an interrupted preparation can therefore leave readiness and the persisted fingerprint unchanged when all recognized evidence remains valid.
findings.comparison: record_audit.require_order rejects such event-looking malformed lines.
findings.related_parser_inconsistency: freeze progress fields use dict(re.findall(...)), silently selecting the last duplicate identity field; audit parsing rejects duplicates. This duplicate-field case is fingerprinted if its full event line is recognized, so it is a separate parsing ambiguity rather than the unchanged-fingerprint example.
findings.recommended_narrow_correction: Reject malformed event-looking lines and duplicate identity fields consistently before computing readiness/fingerprint. Add a focused synthetic malformed-event-after-preparation retry test.
findings.live_data_status: No live progress/audit/freeze state was inspected; this finding does not assert any actual task event is malformed.

otherwise_consistent: Shared preview/final metadata and report staging
Fingerprint refusal for changed recognized event and retained file/history/session evidence

changes: Reject completion/audit-looking lines that do not match the event grammar.
Reject duplicate identity fields before interpreting identities or computing the retry fingerprint.

coverage: Malformed event appended after interrupted preparation is rejected by readiness and writing retry without writes.
Duplicate identity fields are rejected by parsing itself and retry without writes.
Unchanged retry preserves the manifest and verifies107 synthetic files.
